name: cross-model conversation sensitivity comparison
status: specified before the 8B and 32B cue-map runs
question: How closely does the conversation cue map agree across 3B, 8B, and 32B instruction models?

fixed_design.probe_training: The same 300 complete counterfactual groups per class, group-preserving 70/15/15 splits, five split seeds, full-conversation inputs, layer selector, and logistic probe recipe are used for every model.
fixed_design.controlled_pairs: A shared panel of 505 pairs over 48 base messages.
fixed_design.readout_suffixes: The default suffix in all four views and three paraphrases in current_help.
fixed_design.primary_estimand: Within each model, the five-seed mean maximum absolute class-logit change, averaged across two current-turn shells, minus matched random-control movement by base.
fixed_design.inference: Base-cluster bootstrap and sign flips with Benjamini-Hochberg correction across 36 cells.

probe_gate.required: Every attribute must reach held-out balanced accuracy of at least 0.75 for every split seed.
probe_gate.failure_rule: A model that fails the gate is excluded from claims about cross-model cue-map agreement.

cross_model_endpoints: Spearman rank correlation across the 36 primary cue-by-readout cells.
Direction agreement and corrected-significance overlap for the 30 cells significant in the 3B panel.
Agreement of the highest-moving readout for each cue category.
Agreement of one-turn and two-turn retention for six selected cue-readout pairs.

interpretation.primary: Rank and directional agreement indicate that the cue structure is not peculiar to one checkpoint.
interpretation.scale_warning: Raw probe-logit magnitudes are not compared across models because independently fitted probes do not share a calibrated unit.
interpretation.scope_warning: Agreement across three open-weight instruction models does not establish validity for proprietary systems or demographic truth.
